name: City of Davis Summer Camp Recreation Leader Jobs
org: City of Davis Parks and Community Services
what_you_do: You lead games, crafts and sports for kids ages 6 to 12 at city day camps. You help watch campers and teen helpers. You give simple first aid and keep camp safe.
who_can_apply: Summer Playgrounds camps (Rainbow Summer, Summer Quest, Kids in the Kitchen, Arts and Crafts, Kinder Camp, PM Kids Club, Teen Camp): 15 or older before camp starts. Outdoor camps (Camp Putah, Summer Sampler, Backyard Adventures): 16 or older. You must own a bike and ride up to 10 miles a day. Both jobs need CPR and First Aid cards before camp starts.
pay_detail: 2026: $16.97 per hour (Community Services Specialist I). Temporary part-time, no benefits.
duration: June through August. 2026 camps ran ten weeks, June 15 to August 21, Monday to Friday. Summer Playgrounds shifts fall between 7:30 a.m. and 6:00 p.m. (schedules vary).
deadline_text: No camp job is posted as of Oct 16, 2026, and 2027 dates are not posted. Last cycle: Summer Playgrounds Recreation Leader (2026) opened Feb 16, 2026; the posting listed a final filing date of Friday, Feb 27 or until filled, and a closing date of Mar 3, 2026. Recreation Leader, Outdoor Education (2026) opened Feb 19, 2026 with an application deadline of Mar 16, 2026 or until filled. In 2025 these jobs opened Feb 4 and Jan 22. Expect new postings around late January to February 2027.
how_to_apply: Apply online on the city's NEOGOV jobs page. Paper forms are not taken. Good fits get an email to set up an interview. In 2026, Summer Playgrounds picks had to be free on Friday, March 13 for a group interview day.
notes: In 2026, all staff had to come to training on June 6. More trainings ran June 1 to 13. Staff also met on Monday or Tuesday nights in summer and took online trainings. Other leader jobs open to teens: Inclusion Recreation Leader (2025 post: 15 for level I, 16 for level II, open Jan 22 to Apr 1, 2025). There is also a fall leader job for the Davis Children's Nutcracker. It needs you to be 15 with a work permit and pays $16.97 an hour. The 2026 post ran Aug 31 to Sep 28, 2026, and the work runs Nov 9 to Dec 13. Senior leader and Camp Putah leader jobs need you to be 18 or a high school grad. Paid work under 18 needs a California work permit.
